work: Published the dedicated Schwarzwaldbob alpine coaster as a standalone attraction with eight editorial descriptions, two exact licensed photos, official fares, dated opening hours, access conditions and a Facebook announcement.
qualification: Operator pricing presents the alpine coaster as the primary ride and trampolines, electric cars and excavators as coin-operated side games. The hidden legacy Park and its sole ParkItem were retained as NotRelevant by controlled migration.
sourceLimitations: Operator technical table says 850 m of downhill track while prose says almost 1000 m; structured length uses the technical table.
The photo portal identifies CC BY-SA but does not state a version; credits do not invent one.
Opening hours encode the currently published November 2026 and Christmas to 6 January 2027 dates, conditional on good weather; revisit the next main season.
